title: Aqua Debris
description: Aqua Debris is a simple resource pack that gives Ancient Debris a clean cyan-blue look, making it easier to spot in the Nether. It keeps a smooth vanilla-style design while improving visibility for mining and survival gameplay.
body:
Aqua Debris is a simple resource pack that changes Ancient Debris into a clean cyan-blue style, making it easier to spot in the Nether while still keeping a vanilla-inspired look. Designed for players who want better visibility without making the texture too distracting or overdetailed. Lightweight, smooth, and perfect for survival, PvP, and Nether mining.

Features:

Cyan/Light blue Ancient Debris
Easy to spot in the Nether
Clean and simple design
Vanilla styled texture
Lightweight and optimized
Great for Survival and PvP
Better Nether mining experience
